verdict.rationale: IDSync is mParticle's documented identity resolution framework. It builds a unified customer view and gives visibility into, and control over, known and anonymous user identities across apps and platforms. That covers anonymous-to-known stitching into one profile across devices. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of configurable resolution rules (e.g., identity priority or merge strategies), detail on how anonymous profiles are merged at login, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
